title: Riverbend Medical Hardship Renewals — Treatment Recency Allowance
content:
| Latest date of service, counted back from the notice date | Days added |
|---|---|
| no more than 14 days before the notice date (a date of service on or after the notice date included) | 14 |
| more than 14 and no more than 30 days before the notice date | 7 |
| more than 30 days before, or no charge line posted | none |

The table states the days added to the response days of a renewal's missing-information notice under the Financial Assistance Program (Charity Care) for a patient still in treatment, read from the latest date of service on any charge line of the patient's Hospital Account (Encounter Billing) accounts.

**Boundary cases (hypothetical notice date 2030-04-30).** A latest date of service of 2030-04-16 (14 days before) adds 14 days; 2030-04-15 (15 days before) adds 7; 2030-03-31 (30 days before) adds 7; 2030-03-30 (31 days before) adds none; a date of service of 2030-05-02 adds 14.
